cfgp_lead: Start with a profile. Refine the details when you need to.
cfgp_profiles_lead: One card per profile in .jgates/profiles.yml. The default profile is the one JGates uses when no other is requested.
cfgp_create_id_help: Lowercase letters, numbers, dot, hyphen and underscore. Example: fast.
cfgp_changes_none: This profile changes nothing compared to its parent.
cfgp_rename_note: Profiles that extend this one and the default profile start pointing to the new identifier.
cfgp_default_set: The profile {id} is now the default (selection.profile in jgates.yml).
cfgp_delete_text: The profile leaves .jgates/profiles.yml. A profile that is the default, or that another one extends, is not deleted.
cfgp_selection_errors: The selection of this profile has problems:
cfgp_protect_title: What do you want to protect?
cfgp_protect_lead: Turns checks on and off in the profile {profile}. Each category opens into capabilities, tools and rules.
cfgp_readonly_notice: {profile} is a starter profile and cannot be edited. Create a project profile from it to change the checks.
cfgp_no_tools: No tool in the project runs this capability.
cfgp_tool_shared: Turning this tool off also turns it off in: {others}. It serves {capability} and those capabilities.
cfgp_locked_reason: Locked by the policy: {reason} Defined in {file}.
cfgp_reason_DERIVED: On because something inside it is on.
cfgp_policy_lead: Approval criteria, independent of intensity. Written to .jgates/policy.yml.
cfgp_not_applied: Declared in the policy, not applied by the engine yet: the blocking decision does not read this rule yet.
cfgp_severity_help: Findings below this level stay in the report.
cfgp_coverage_denominator: Denominator: {denominator}. Each component has its own minimum; there is no average across components of different sizes.
cfgp_missing_label: Block when a check is missing
cfgp_missing_block_help: An unavailable tool does not count as approval: the validation stays incomplete and blocks.
cfgp_missing_warn_help: A missing check becomes a visible warning in the result. It never counts as silent approval.
cfgp_governed_reason: Governed mode: this value comes from the policy {policy}, outside the repository, and does not change here.
cfgp_governed_missing: Governed mode: the policy {policy} always blocks when a check is missing.
cfgp_files_note: Each control shows the file it writes to and the origin of the value. The plan shows the result of combining with the templates.
origin_chain_label: Chain of layers, from strongest to weakest
origin_reason_EXPLICIT: A layer chose this value explicitly.
origin_reason_DERIVED: The value comes from something more specific that is on inside it.
origin_reason_LOCKED_REQUIRED: The policy requires this check and nobody had selected it.
origin_no_chain: This value does not come from a configuration field.
origin_where_readonly: This is a starter profile and is not editable: create a project profile from it.
